item.title: PeakRDL
item.description: PeakRDL is a free and open-source control & status register (CSR) automation toolchain. This project provides a command-line tool that unifies many aspects of register automation centered around the SystemRDL register description language. This tool can: Process SystemRDL 2.0 register descriptions. Import & export IP-XACT XML. Generate synthesizable SystemVerilog RTL register blocks using APB, AXI4-Lite, Avalon, and other interfaces. Create rich and dynamic HTML documentation. Build a UVM register model abstraction layer.
